description:
In Episode 163 we have a change of scenery. On our way back from a camp meeting in Namibia, we camped next to the Okavango River in the Caprivi strip in the North of Namibia, bordering Angola and Botswana. 
Here between the lush trees and beautiful chirping birds, we discuss the hope filled prophecy of the only person worthy to open the seals of the scroll in Revelation 5. The Spirit of Prophecy admonishes that is of great importance for all who are to act a part in the work of God in the last days, to study this chapter carefully. Worthy is the Lamb.
